compose.none: No links with other creations yet.
compose.missing: This project has no such collection.
compose.shared: Collections show only in this project’s own tasks.
compose.loop: Not shown: each would use the other, in a loop.
compose.journal: Changes not in a version yet: {count}
compose.breaks: No version can be made while these columns have another kind: {columns}. Give them back their kind, or add new columns.
compose.unpublished: This collection has no version yet.
compose.recipe: Not shown: what it keeps names a column or a value this collection hasn’t.
compose.failed: The last update failed; the one before stays on show.
compose.unasked: Not shown yet: no brain could carry out what it asks.
compose.certified: Certified, back to version {n} of the collection
compose.certifiedLive: Certified, from the collection’s rows as they were then
compose.uncertified: The rows as they are now: no version, so no certificate
compose.unproven: Its certificates don’t hold: changed, or not sealed by the key they name
compose.port: A site’s form can fill {columns}; only you approve, in “{approval}”.
